cases.name: Inquisitor Captain
cases.text:
Vigilance
When this creature enters, if you cast it and there are twenty or more creature cards with mana value 3 or less among cards in your graveyard, hand, and library, seek two creature cards with mana value 3 or less. Put one of them onto the battlefield and shuffle the other into your library.
